findings.problem: Host delivery does not require actual post-apply file hashes to equal the result of the current reviewed patch, and has no explicit prepare/complete success handoff.
findings.evidence: host-byte-binding-counterexample.json: checks exit 0 after adding an unreviewed assignment; actual hash differs from approved target hash. This is an offline contract counterexample, not a production exploit.
findings.required: Bind task/attempt/artifact/review/baseline/application receipt and actual post-apply bytes; specify pending-host then verified-complete lifecycle. No succeeded/target_applied based on reference-only tests or receipt booleans.

findings.problem: Task templates are not materialized/validated against the existing protocol and actual fixture inputs. Code task has an illegal top-level acceptance_note; data records is prose, and replacing it with different real records still passes checker.
findings.evidence: independent-probes-confirmation.json: code_sortfix_task_schema error; data resolver refuses original; data_input_mismatch exits 0.
findings.required: Move explanatory key into metadata; use the actual six-record list or deterministic materialization; validate current Task Schema after filling workspace; compare task input/input.json/expected.json.

findings.problem: Seal/authorization/spec guards permit empty or incomplete manifests, truthy string sealed flag, absolute Windows target, empty scenarios/checks, and bool sales.
findings.evidence: Eight isolated inconsistent variants exit 0 in both runs; copied fixtures only.
findings.required: Strict boolean seal, closed exact manifest inventory and nonempty required case/check sets, unique relative paths and Windows drive rejection, strict input types and existing template semantics; mutation checks must fail by relevant assertions, not harness errors.

findings.problem: Reference changes docstring bytes despite the single-edit byte contract; current executable commands cover reference/baseline controls, without a separate bound post-apply command.
findings.evidence: reference_byte_contract false; fixed reference passes 4/4 while baseline fails first two as expected.
findings.required: Reference equals baseline with exactly the one parameter removed; keep control commands separate and add a materialized post-apply command bound to the actual authorized workspace target.

limitations: All current N2 delivery/fault cases remain not_run; only fixture controls and offline consistency probes ran.
